units.source_en: “Yes. At such a time, the other man will certainly gain nothing, but your own loss will be greater still.
units.source_zh: “是，那时，对方固然不会有益处，而大人的损失更大。

units.source_en: Such moments are unavoidable in the course of a long life.”

ja.t: のうちには、そうしたことを

units.source_zh: 这种事在漫长的一生中是不可避免的。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是，那时，对方固然不会有益处，而大人的损失更大。这种事在漫长的一生中是不可避免的。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi avoided Rikyū’s gaze and said, “You have a bad habit of your own, Master.”

units.source_en: Hideyoshi avoided Rikyū’s gaze and said, “You have a bad habit of your own, Master.”
units.source_zh: 秀吉避开利休的目光，道：“居士却有个坏毛病。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉避开利休的目光，道：“居士却有个坏毛病。”

paragraphs.source_en: “A bad habit?”

units.source_en: “A bad habit?”
units.source_zh: “毛病？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “毛病？”

paragraphs.source_en: At the thought, Hideyoshi could not help breaking into a broad grin.

units.source_en: At the thought, Hideyoshi could not help breaking into a broad grin.
units.source_zh: 秀吉想着，不由咧嘴笑了。
